question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH wholesale_data AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(w.whsle_date AS DATE)) AS year,
        AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS avg_wholesale_price,
        MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS max_wholesale_price,
        MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS min_wholesale_price,
        MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS wholesale_price_diff,
        SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS total_wholesale_price,
        AVG(l."loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_whsle_df w
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
    JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON w.item_code = l.item_code
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(w.whsle_date AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY c.category_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(w.whsle_date AS DATE))
),
transaction_data AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t.txn_date AS DATE)) AS year,
        SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") AS total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t.txn_date AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY c.category_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t.txn_date AS DATE))
)
SELECT 
    wd.category_name,
    wd.year,
    ROUND(wd.avg_wholesale_price, 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wd.max_wholesale_price, 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wd.min_wholesale_price, 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(wd.wholesale_price_diff, 2) AS wholesale_price_diff,
    ROUND(wd.total_wholesale_price, 2) AS total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(td.total_selling_price, 2) AS total_selling_price,
    ROUND(wd.avg_loss_rate, 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(wd.total_wholesale_price * wd.avg_loss_rate / 100, 2) AS total_loss,
    ROUND(td.total_selling_price - wd.total_wholesale_price, 2) AS profit
FROM wholesale_data wd
JOIN transaction_data td ON wd.category_name = td.category_name AND wd.year = td.year
ORDER BY wd.year, wd.category_name
